description: Full system access with unrestricted control over all platform features, users, clubs, and configuration.
Platform administrator with broad access to manage clubs, users, catalogs, and system settings.
Assistant administrator who supports platform management tasks with limited administrative privileges.
Regional or district coordinator responsible for overseeing multiple clubs within a geographic area.
Zonal coordinator overseeing clubs in a zone.
General coordinator overseeing zone coordinators in a local field.
Local-field director.
Local-field assistant director.
Union director.
Union assistant director.
Division director.
Division assistant director.
Church pastor with visibility into club activities and spiritual oversight responsibilities.
Standard authenticated user with access to their own profile and club membership data.
Club director responsible for overall club leadership, planning, and operations.
Deputy director who assists the club director and assumes leadership in their absence.
Club secretary responsible for record-keeping, attendance tracking, and administrative documentation.
Club treasurer who manages financial records, budgets, dues, and expense reporting.
Combined secretary and treasurer club role.
Unit counselor who guides and mentors a group of club members in their spiritual and personal development.
Instructor who teaches honors, classes, and specialized skills to club members.
Regular club member participating in Pathfinder, Adventurer, or Master Guide club activities.
